avisos.mensagem: Historical frequency computed from the observed series (IMERG and POWER), one simulation per year. It is not a prediction for the next season.
risco_zarc_pct is the official risk from the ZARC ordinance; risco_historico_falha_severa is the frequency simulated by TELLUS; margem_r_ha is economic. They are different measures.

D-006: scenarios from the quartiles of simulated loss — conservative = 75th percentile (worst in 1 of every 4 years), central = median, favorable = 25th percentile. Product decision, no industry source; editable.

proveniencia.qualidade: only 10-day periods inside the official window are included (FR-002)

proveniencia.fonte: TELLUS water-balance engine (spec 006), same versioned inputs as the risco_hidrico section
proveniencia.periodo: IMERG/POWER historical series used by the engine (see versoes.motor of each option)
proveniencia.localizacao: point or area in the request

proveniencia.fonte: TELLUS economics (spec 007): Conab cost from the nearest market location and a sourced or farmer-provided price
proveniencia.periodo: reference month of the Conab sheet and price date (see versoes.economia)
proveniencia.localizacao: nearest Conab market location with the crop
proveniencia.qualidade: margin in the conservative, central and favorable scenarios

proveniencia.localizacao: not applicable (rule for reading the scenarios)
proveniencia.qualidade: assumption — conservative P75, central P50, favorable P25

proveniencia.fonte: TELLUS recommendation (spec 008): highest margin in the conservative scenario; lowest historical risk of severe failure; lowest official ZARC risk; earliest planting; final tie-break
proveniencia.periodo: not applicable (ranking of the options in this response)

proveniencia.fonte: Provided by the farmer: Cooperativa de Rio Verde (teste)
proveniencia.localizacao: provided by the farmer (Cooperativa de Rio Verde (teste))
proveniencia.qualidade: provided by the farmer; no official indicator (D-005)

avisos.mensagem: Historical frequency computed from the observed series (IMERG and POWER), one simulation per year. It is not a prediction for the next season.
risco_zarc_pct is the official risk from the ZARC ordinance; risco_historico_falha_severa is the frequency simulated by TELLUS; margem_r_ha is economic. They are different measures.

D-006: scenarios from the quartiles of simulated loss — conservative = 75th percentile (worst in 1 of every 4 years), central = median, favorable = 25th percentile. Product decision, no industry source; editable.

decisao.pergunta: Which index, minimum period and quality rule answer the area context question?

produtos_modis.nota: Operational assumption of the prototype: MODIS/Terra MOD13Q1 v061. MYD13Q1 (Aqua) is supported but off by default.

indice.nota: Operational assumption of the prototype: NDVI. The request can switch to EVI.

janela_meses.nota: Operational assumption: initial series of the last 12 months, counted from the latest composite available in the cache (not from the clock), so the same cache gives the same response. inicio/fim in the request replace the window.

minimo_composicoes_validas.nota: Provisional minimum: with fewer than 6 valid composites in the window, the series is declared 'insufficient'. Nothing is filled in.

regra_qualidade_modis.fonte: Didan, K.; Barreto Munoz, A. MODIS Vegetation Index User's Guide (MOD13 Series), Collection 6.1, Version 3.10, September 2019 — section 5.5.2 'QA Science Data Sets', Table 4 (MOD13Q1/A1 Pixel Reliability) and Table 5 (VI Quality, bits 0–1, 8, 10, 14 and 15); valid range and fill value: section 5.2, Table 1.
regra_qualidade_modis.nota: Product rule applied: rank 0 ('Good Data — use with confidence') becomes a value; rank 1 ('Marginal data — useful, but look at other QA information') becomes a value only if VI Quality says 'VI produced' (bits 0–1 = 00 or 01) and does not flag adjacent cloud (bit 8), mixed clouds (bit 10), possible snow/ice (bit 14) or possible shadow (bit 15); rank 2 (snow/ice), 3 (cloud) and −1 (no data) become gaps. The choice of bits checked for rank 1 is a prototype assumption.

regra_qualidade_hls.fonte: Ju, J. et al. Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 (HLS) Product User Guide, Product Version 2.0 (updated April 2026) — section 6.4 'Quality Assessment Layer', Table 9.
regra_qualidade_hls.nota: Cloud (bit 1), adjacent to cloud/shadow (bit 2), shadow (bit 3) and snow/ice (bit 4) become gaps. Bit 0 (cirrus) is reserved and not used in v2.0. A band with fill value (−9999) is always a gap.

cobertura_minima_area.nota: Fraction (by area weight) of valid pixels required for a composite to become the area value. 1.0 = any invalid pixel makes the whole area a gap; nothing is filled in.
